What is the design of this sports bra, and how does it benefit me during workouts?
The sports bra features a racerback design with wide shoulder straps, which evenly distribute weight across your shoulders. This reduces pressure points and provides added comfort and freedom of movement during your workouts.
What types of workouts is this sports bra good for?

top_reviews.title: Great Value, Consider Sizing Up for Comfort!
top_reviews.variant: Size: Medium Color: Black Number of Items: 3
top_reviews.body: I recently purchased the Match Women's Sports Bra Wirefree Seamless Padded Racerback Yoga Bra, and overall, I'm quite satisfied with my purchase. First off, let's talk about the value. Getting three sports bras for a great price is definitely a win in my book. It's a fantastic deal, especially considering the quality of the product. The seamless design and padded cups provide a smooth and comfortable fit, which is perfect for workouts and yoga sessions. The racerback style offers great support and freedom of movement, allowing me to focus on my activities without any discomfort. However, I did find that the sizing runs a bit small. I ordered a size medium as I usually wear, but I found the bras to be tighter than expected. If you prefer a more relaxed fit, I would recommend sizing up for optimal comfort. Despite the sizing issue, I still appreciate the overall quality and value of these sports bras. They're well-made, comfortable, and perfect for low to medium-impact activities. Plus, having three bras in different colors provides variety and options for mixing and matching with my workout outfits. In conclusion, if you're looking for affordable and functional sports bras, the Match Women's Sports Bra set is definitely worth considering. Just be mindful of the sizing and consider sizing up for a more comfortable fit.

top_reviews.title: Not for running if youve got large tracks of land
top_reviews.variant: Size: Large Color: Black Number of Items: 3
top_reviews.body: Im rockin’ 38 DD’s and was hoping these would hold the girls down while i run. The chart recommended a 3XL which seemed absurd so i ignored that nonsense and got a large. Im really glad i did. The large is snug, holds the tata’s in place BUT there’s no way i can actually run in them. I tried but i was worried if i kept going i’d give myself two black eyes with how much they bounced. Im pretty sure i looked like Norbit chasing down the ice cream truck. I’ll be keeping these since theyre actually a nice bra to workout in or just to wear on days Im annoyed with a real bra which is basically every day so… Oh. I wonder if i could run if i wore two of them at once?? Nah. Id probably just look like a bouncing can of busted biscuits.

top_reviews.title: These are great for busty women
top_reviews.variant: Size: Large Color: Black Number of Items: 3
top_reviews.body: These are wonderful for busty women. These really came in clutch when I’ve had to run randomly (across the street or in a rush) or when cleaning up the house or when I go to the gym. These are comfy enough to wear at home while lounging. These are supportive of my 38 DDD breasts and they are very flattering on me. The only downside is that sometimes, the thicker/rough material will make my sensitive spots (if you know that I mean) on my breasts itch. I thought it would go away, but I’ve been wearing them almost daily, and they still make me itch. It would be nice, if there was a softer material on the inside of the bra cups. However, it’s a small price to pay to have the occasional itchy breasts to have nice bras. I’m still looking into similar bras with slightly softer material. These are great to wear at the gym, though, so even if I find other bras that are softer, I will still wear these at the gym. I hand wash my bras and I’ve noticed over a few weeks, this starts to stretch out. Next time I order, I’ll order a size down, because even though it will be tight at first, they will stretch out over time.

top_reviews.title: So comfy! Zero support.
top_reviews.variant: Size: Medium Color: Plum Number of Items: 1
top_reviews.body: I purchased this bra in size M in plum (the name of the hot pink colour.) I wear a 36C bra normally, and this sports bra fit me perfectly. The fabric is incredibly soft and comfortable. It has held up well to washing (no shrink, loss of shape, or issues with colour bleeding.) The reason I gave this bra only 3 stars is that it offers very little support, and the cups are not really appropriately sized. I was hoping for a running bra, but this is actually the least supportive of all of the bras and bralettes I own. I decided to keep it because of the low price, and the comfort level. It's great for wearing around the house. I wore it outside for gardening (I often just go bra-less), and it was perfect for that. I did remove the cups as they were wrinkled and far too small, forming bizarre circle shapes on my chest. If you need a budget-friendly, comfy, low support option with tons of stretch in a great neon colour, this is the bra for you.

top_reviews.title: Love it buuuuut...
top_reviews.body: I'm only giving this 5 stars because I already have some larger foam inserts from a different top. As other reviewers mention, the ones that come in this sports bra are confusingly small. The "XXL" inserts in the picture are the ones that came with the top. They may look OK, on the floor, but those inserts are definitely undersized and difficult to find a good position for once the bra is begin worn. That aside, and with larger padding swapped in, this top is exactly what I wanted. It's snug, comfy, and looks seamless under a swim shirt/rash guard.

top_reviews.title: MY FAVE!
top_reviews.body: This has been one of my go to bras for the last 2 years! The electric green is so much fun and goes well with ravewear for my aerial performance wardrobe. Super comfortable material, true to size. Solid stitching to keep the girls in place, the band underneath is thick and a bit longer so it almost feels like a very fitted crop top tank. Love this one! Will always come back for more!
